records.rationale: The diff adds group_member.hbs with `{{#unless automatic}}` rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`; the view for each item is a Discourse.View whose content is a Discourse.User, and nothing in the diff passes the group's `automatic` property into that view, so the remove-link guard would not reflect the group's automatic flag — matching the described mechanism (remove link shown on automatic groups, removal rejected with 422). records.issue_text: [Medium/data] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:61 (add_members) — unknown usernames are silently skipped (if user = User.find_by_username(username)) and success_json is still returned even if zero members were actually added; the client gets no error or partial-success signal, so a typo'd username looks like a successful add (the UI just reloads with the member missing).
records.rationale: The diff shows add_members iterating `usernames.split(",").each do |username| if user = User.find_by_username(username) group.add(user)...` then unconditionally returning success_json; a typo'd username is silently skipped and the client receives success, so the UI reloads with the member missing and no error — a real correctness/UX defect visible in the new code.
